fenix-capital-inmo-map.note: FACT-001 is integrated in PREPROD; PROD promotion remains separate.

fenix-core-guard.risk: Branch names are not interchangeable canonical sources. Staging contains the newest validated PREPROD line; production represents the deployed release line; main is materially stale and must not be treated as canonical without an explicit reconciliation plan.

policy: Do not fast-forward or merge staging to main merely to make branch counts match.
Do not promote staging to production without production gates, backup, OLD vs NEW, runtime smoke and rollback.
Do not delete legacy branches until dependency and release provenance are preserved.
administrative_gap: Critical branch protection is not enabled/evidenced and current connector permissions do not expose a safe branch-protection write path.
